stages.name: kill an idle cog at 25 m
stages.definition: An idle enemy 25 m away in the open, facing away. Score: share of its 3 HP removed in 6 s.

stages.name: hit a strafing cog at 25 m
stages.definition: An enemy 25 m away walking side to side (2 s legs), never shooting. Score: share of its 3 HP removed in 8 s.

stages.name: kill an idle cog at 45 m
stages.definition: An idle enemy 45 m away in view. Score: share of its 3 HP removed in 8 s.

stages.name: 1v1 duel vs base.bas, face to face
stages.definition: One base.bas cog 25 m away, both facing each other, full HP. Score: 100 kill without dying, 50 a trade, 0 death; a timeout scores 50 plus the HP difference.

stages.name: 1v1 vs base.bas shooting from behind
stages.definition: As the duel, but we face away and the base.bas cog starts behind us. Same score.

stages.name: survive 1v2 vs base.bas
stages.definition: Two base.bas cogs 25 m away facing us. Score: 100 alive after 10 s, 0 dead; +25 per kill, capped at 100.

stages.name: win 2v1 vs base.bas without a loss
stages.definition: Two of our cogs 4 m apart vs one base.bas cog 25 m away. Score: 100 enemy dead and no loss, 50 enemy dead with a loss, 0 otherwise.

stages.name: 4v4 team fight vs base.bas
stages.definition: Four of ours vs four base.bas 30 m apart, 20 s, no respawns counted. Score: 50 + 12.5 per enemy death - 12.5 per own death.

stages.name: grenade a cluster of three
stages.definition: We hold a grenade; three idle enemies stand together 14 m away in view. Score: grenade damage dealt over the 9 HP in reach, in 6 s.

stages.name: heal at a medkit when hurt
stages.definition: At 1 HP, a ready medkit 10 m away, no enemies. Score: 100 healed within 10 s.

stages.name: pick up nearby armor
stages.definition: Full HP, ready armor 8 m away, no enemies. Score: 100 armored within 10 s.

stages.name: capture a neutral heart alone
stages.definition: 15 m from a neutral heart, no enemies. Score: 100 captured within 15 s.

stages.name: stop a capture of our heart
stages.definition: An idle enemy starts capturing our heart; we stand 20 m away. Score: 100 capture stopped for 6 s.

stages.name: collect a glory heart
stages.definition: A glory heart 10 m away, no enemies. Score: 100 picked up within 10 s.

stages.name: hold fire through a teammate
stages.definition: An idle enemy 30 m away with an idle teammate halfway on the line. Score: 50 for no friendly damage, 50 more for any enemy damage, in 8 s.

stages.name: 8v8 match vs base.bas
stages.definition: Full 8v8 on Heartwick vs base.bas, 3 minute cap, sides alternate. Score: 100 win, 50 draw or unfinished, 0 loss.
